text:
Sam (Product): Quick follow-up from today's all‑hands — can leadership confirm the public API GA window, Console rollout parity timeline, and Optimize beta availability? Need dates for planning. @Elaine @Kevin

Elaine (Eng): API GA target is end of Q3 (aiming 2025-09-30) but two infra blockers remain: multi-model routing and cold-start P95. Working on fixes this sprint.

Kevin (Product Ops): Console parity for the rollout UI is in the Dedicated sprint next month. ETA: canary mid‑Aug, full rollout mid‑Sept. We'll provide a migration guide for existing customers.

Priya (Optimize PM): Optimize beta is slated for late Sep. Beta invites go out week of 2025-09-22. Beta feature set: batching suggestions, cache inspector, cost simulator.

Jonah (Eng Runtime): Multi-model routing is partially rolled out; canary scheduled tomorrow. Cold-start P95 improvements landed in a branch but need load testing before promoting.

Sam (Product): Thanks — can we get a short ownership list + a public comms date? Any Dedicated customer risk flags?

Maya (Customer Success): Dedicated customers are asking about Console changes — they'd like a heads-up doc and staging access. We should coordinate with sales for early adopters.

Elaine (Eng): We'll share console staging by 2025-07-25. If Dedicated customers want early access, send names to eng-priv-access.

Kevin (Product Ops): Owning comms: me + Priya. Proposal: public blog + release notes on 2025-10-01. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Priya (Optimize PM): That works. Beta invites should go out before the blog.

Sam (Product): I'll draft release-note bullets. Can someone add technical bullets for the blog (routing, quant profiles, cache behavior)?

Jonah (Eng Runtime): Quick note: Optimize needs quantization profile v2 support; I'll merge that by 2025-08-10. Also will confirm perf numbers after canary.

DevOps-bot: deploy scheduled: console-staging -> staging on 2025-07-25 02:00 UTC :rocket:

Sam (Product): Action items: @Elaine runtime canary tomorrow; @Jonah merge quant profiles by 2025-08-10; @Kevin draft comms calendar; @Priya prepare beta invites. I'll draft release bullets and share by EOD.

Maya (Customer Success): I'll start the early adopter doc and sync with Sales for the list.

Kevin (Product Ops): Noted — I'll post a timeline in #product later today.

Sam (Product): Thanks everyone :heart:
